name: Cold Blood
source:
A spider working for Song An.
Together with Jing Ke and Lan Yu, he set up the Temple Street terror operation.
He warned Ivy, a hostess he met and liked during the preparations, to stay away from Temple Street around the day of the attack.
Yvet was informed by Ivy and the Red Flower society began to investigate the attack.
His motto is "Gentle with the ladies".
